title: Integrated Scholarships
eligibility: Student studying in a government college
Family income from all sources not exceeding INR 54,000 per year according to the retrieved official record
For students not covered by other scholarships
benefits: Financial assistance for continuing higher education and training
application_process: New applicants are selected on merit
Students apply through the head of their educational institution in the prescribed format
important_sections_or_clauses: The record distinguishes general education students and Sanskrit scholarship applicants.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
